United States.text: The McDonald brothers opened the first one in San Bernardino in 1940, hoping to make $1 million before 50.
United States.evidence: Siblings Richard and Maurice McDonald, with the goal of making $1 million before they turned 50, opened the first McDonald's at 1398 North E Street at West 14th Street in San Bernardino, California, on May 15, 1940.

China.text: The first opened in Shenzhen in 1990; in Beijing, McDonald's restaurants were once state-owned enterprises.
China.evidence: McDonald's opened its first restaurant in China, in Shenzhen, Guangdong in 1990. ... In Beijing, China, McDonald's restaurants once were state-owned enterprises operating according to franchise agreements.

Japan.text: Founder Den Fujita predicted 10,000 McDonald's in Japan by 2010. It has about 3,000.
Japan.evidence: Den Fujita ... was the founder of McDonald's Japan. ... His ambitions, however, did not recede with age as he predicted that there would be 10,000 McDonald's in Japan by 2010. (List of countries with McDonald's restaurants: Japan, 3,025 outlets, December 31, 2025.)

France.text: In 2009 McDonald's France swapped the red in its logo for green, to look kinder to the environment.
France.evidence: In 2009, McDonald's France modified its logo, replacing the red color with green, in a marketing strategy to fight against the reputation of being environmentally unconscious and present a greener image.

Canada.text: After the 2025 4 Nations Face-Off, two Canadian restaurants were briefly renamed McDavid's, after Connor McDavid.
Canada.evidence: In February 2025, following the 4 Nations Face-Off with Canada and the United States, McDonald's Canada temporarily renamed two restaurants in Edmonton, Alberta and Newmarket, Ontario to McDavid's, named after Edmonton Oilers captain Connor McDavid.

United Kingdom.text: Its McLibel suit against two activists ran for ten years, the longest legal action in UK history.
United Kingdom.evidence: The longest-running legal action of all time in the UK was the McLibel case against two defendants who criticized several aspects of the company. The trial lasted ten years and called 130 witnesses.

Germany.text: Germans call it Mäkkes; the first opened in Munich in 1971, and East Germany got its first in Plauen in 1990.
Germany.evidence: First outlet in West Germany opened in Munich-Obergiesing in 1971. McDonald's is locally known as Mäkkes. First outlet in the new states of Germany opened in Plauen in 1990 following reunification.

Brazil.text: Brazilians call it Méqui; the first opened on Copacabana, Rio de Janeiro, in 1979.
Brazil.evidence: First outlet opened in Copacabana, Rio de Janeiro, in 1979. First outlet opened in South America and first outlet in a lusophone country. Locally known as Méqui.

Australia.text: McCafé was invented by McDonald's Australia, starting in Melbourne in 1993.
Australia.evidence: McCafé is a café-style accompaniment to McDonald's restaurants. The concept was created by McDonald's Australia, starting with Melbourne in 1993.

Philippines.text: Filipino McDonald's has sold McSpaghetti, a sweet tomato pasta with frankfurter bits, since 1986.
Philippines.evidence: The McSpaghetti, a sweet tomato pasta with Frankfurter bits introduced in 1986.
